name: Jezero reference points and USGS map-label anchors
description: An offline index of the published landing and crater reference points plus named USGS nomenclature label anchors. The anchors label map features; they are not boundaries or surveyed feature centers. Use the companion polygon and line layers for the geologic shapes.

marsCoordinateSystem.note: Coordinates use Mars longitude and latitude; they are not Earth WGS 84 coordinates.

properties.name: Octavia E. Butler Landing
properties.sourceLabel: Stack et al. 2023, Journal of Geophysical Research: Planets
properties.note: Published Perseverance touchdown coordinate; point location, not a landing-ellipse boundary.

properties.name: Jezero Crater center
properties.sourceLabel: USGS Gazetteer of Planetary Nomenclature, Feature 14300
properties.note: Gazetteer center only; does not represent the crater rim geometry.

properties.name: Marysville
properties.sourceLabel: Sun and Stack (2020), USGS Scientific Investigations Map 3464, Nomenclature layer
properties.anchorMethod: centroid of USGS text annotation geometry
properties.note: This coordinate places the map label. It is not the center, surveyed location, or boundary of the named feature.
